<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='MuseEkgRes:ResPdf24' targetDocType='MuseEkgRes:ResPdf24' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Transforms Hl7 PDF results to Cerner</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='' property='target.{MSH:SendingFacility}' action='clear' /> <assign value='"iCENTRA"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='""' property='obx3Val' action='set' /> <assign value='"P"' property='target.{MSH:ProcessingID.processingID}' action='set' /> <assign value='2.3' property='target.{MSH:VersionID.versionID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:SetIDPID}' property='target.{PID:SetIDPID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"EMPI"' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().assigningauthority.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' />
<assign value='source.{OBR}' property='target.{OBR}' action='set' /> <assign value='"LUMEDX_"_source.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}_"_"_source.{MSH:DateTimeOfMessage.timeofanevent}_".pdf"' property='pdfFileName' action='set' /> <assign value='##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Utility).GetHddObject(context.hddNcidResponse, "OBR41:Id")' property='hddObjNcid' action='set' /> <if condition='hddObjNcid '=""' > <true> <if condition='hddObjNcid.NCID '=""' > <true> <assign value='hddObjNcid.NCID' property='target.{OBR:UniversalServiceIdentifier.identifierST}' action='set' /> <assign value='hddObjNcid.NCID' property='obx3Val' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{OBR:UniversalServiceIdentifier.identifierST}' property='target.{OBR:UniversalServiceIdentifier.identifierST}' action='set' /> </false> </if> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{OBR:UniversalServiceIdentifier.identifierST}' property='target.{OBR:UniversalServiceIdentifier.identifierST}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='source.{OBR:ResultStatus}' property='rs' action='set' /> <if condition='rs=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{ORC:OrderStatus}' property='rs' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='rs' property='target.{OBR:ResultStatus}' action='set' />
<foreach property='context.base64Strs' key='k1' > <assign value='k1' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:SetIDOBX}' action='set' /> <assign value='"ED"' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:ValueType}' action='set' /> <assign value='obx3Val' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:ObservationIdentifier.identifierST}' action='set' /> <assign value='"1"' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:ObservationSubId}' action='set' /> <assign value='"LumedxPdf^multipart^Octet-stream^Base64^"_context.base64Strs.GetAt(k1)' property='obx5' action='set' /> <assign value='obx5' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:ObservationValue(1)}' action='set' /> <assign value='rs' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:ObservationResultStatus}' action='set' /> <assign value='pdfFileName' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:UserDefinedAccessChecks}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{OBR:ObservationDateTime.timeofanevent}' property='target.{OBXgrp(k1).OBX:DateTimeoftheObservation.timeofanevent}' action='set' /> </foreach>
</transform>
